messages:
maya: Tiny gratitude check-in! Massive thanks to @shelby and @lukas for pairing on the canary yesterday and catching the weird mem spike.

shelby: Shoutout to @lukas for the flame-graph voodoo. Also @people-ops-bot  can we do a small snack drop for folks who stayed late?

lukas: lol flame-graph voodoo. Was fun tbh. I ran `perf record --call-graph dwarf` and it made the bug scream.

arjun: Big +1. Also thanks to @samira for the rollback checklist that saved the demo.

samira: Quick plug: i added a tiny rollback checklist to the ops repo under /playbooks/demos.md. Feel free to poke.

people-ops-bot: Poll time! "Snack drop for late-night responders" :white_check_mark: Yes / :x: No / :gift: Surprise me. Vote via emoji in-thread.

kevin: :white_check_mark: from me. And appreciation for @maya for juggling the client call while we fixed it.

maya: Thanks! I owe you all some cookies. Also, if folks prefer vouchers instead of physical snacks (remote peeps), tell me here.

devops-bot: Timeline and artifact: https://redwood.internal/incidents/7890 — logs and canary metrics attached.

nick: Confirming the patch trimmed the hot path p95 by ~90ms on staging. Nice work team.

shelby: tiny kudos list: Lukas (traces), Samira (rollback), Arjun (patch), Maya (client ops), Kevin (handoff).

zoe: +1 client was chill. sent them a quick note and a virtual cookie :cookie:. also love the idea of a weekly micro-kudos snippet in the team update.

arjun: Could we add a "thanks" label to PRs so these contributors surface in the weekly? saves copy-paste.

maya: I can add a one-click form for People Ops to generate vouchers + an optional blurb for the micro-newsletter. paste 1-line kudos here if you want included. gifs welcome.

samira: Adding: "Shoutout to Lukas for the traces gif" :frame_with_picture:

maya: Perfect. Ill compile and send out tomorrow. Gratitude mode: full. :sparkles:
